description_en: Queries the operation logs of end users, including events such as cloud computer startup, shutdown, and session disconnection
description_zh: 查询终端用户的操作日志，包括云电脑的开机、关机、会话断开等事件
kebab_example: aliyun ecd describe-client-events --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --end-user-id 289617081308340000 --desktop-id ecd-8fupvkhg0aayu0000 --desktop-ip 10.10.0.0 --directory-id To_be_hidden. --office-site-id cn-hangzhou+dir-bh77qa8nmjot40000 --event-type DESKTOP_DISCONNECT --start-time 2020-11-30T06:32:31Z --end-time 2020-11-31T06:32:31Z --max-results 10 --next-token AAAAAV3MpHK1AP0pfERHZN5pu6nmB7qrRFJ8vmttjxPL0000 --office-site-name test --desktop-name test --event-types DESKTOP_START --biz-language example-string --fill-hardware-info true --end-user-ids example-string --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeClientEvents

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The logon user information, which is a Resource Access Management (RAM) user ID or AD username. If you do not specify this parameter, events of all users in the region are queried
parameters.help_zh: 登录用户信息，RAM用户ID或AD用户名。不指定时，表示查询该地域下所有用户的事件
parameters.name: end_user_id

parameters.help_en: The cloud computer ID. If you do not specify this parameter, all cloud computers in the region are queried
parameters.help_zh: 云电脑ID。不指定时，表示查询该地域下所有云电脑
parameters.name: desktop_id

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the cloud computer. If you do not specify this parameter, events of all cloud computers in the region are queried
parameters.help_zh: 云电脑的IP地址。不指定时，表示查询该地域下所有云电脑的事件
parameters.name: desktop_ip

parameters.help_en: This parameter is not publicly available
parameters.name: directory_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the office network to which the cloud computer belongs. If you do not specify this parameter, user events in all office networks in the region are queried
parameters.help_zh: 云电脑所属的办公网络ID。不指定时，表示查询该地域下所有办公网络下的用户事件
parameters.name: office_site_id

parameters.help_en: The event type to query. If EventTypes is not empty, the EventTypes combination is used as the query filter condition. If both EventTypes and EventType are empty, all events are queried
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的事件类型。当EventTypes不为空时，则以EventTypes组合类型为查询过滤条件。当EventTypes为空，且EventType为空，则查询所有事件
parameters.name: event_type

parameters.help_en: The start time. Specify the time in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC+0. If you do not specify this parameter, events are queried backward from the time specified by `EndTime`
parameters.help_zh:
开始时间。按照https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html标准表示，并需要使用UTC+0时间，格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ。   
如果不填，则按`EndTime`指定的时间往前查询
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time. Specify the time in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC+0. If you do not specify this parameter, the current time is used
parameters.help_zh:
结束时间。按照https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html标准表示，并需要使用UTC+0时间，格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ。    
如果不填，则按当前时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页行数。       
默认值：100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the value of NextToken returned in the previous API call
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The name of the office network
parameters.name: office_site_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the cloud computer
parameters.name: desktop_name

parameters.help_en: The combination of event types to query. You can specify multiple event types. The query results include events of all specified types
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的事件类型组合，可以多个事件组合，查询结果包含所有组合的事件
parameters.name: event_types
